panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Orange during the first hour after a reboot

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Total RAM is shown in the Overview row; used = total - free

panels.title: Storage writes
panels.description: Sectors written per second to the system storage. A sustained high rate wears out the built-in flash.

panels.title: Disk usage
panels.description: Usage of disks from /disk (USB, NVMe, SD, ...)

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Received above zero, transmitted below zero

panels.title: Packets
panels.description: Received above zero, transmitted below zero

panels.title: Link downs
panels.description: How many times the link went down; only non-zero series are shown

panels.title: Peer traffic
panels.description: Received above zero, transmitted below zero

panels.title: Time since last handshake
panels.description: Active peers re-handshake every 2 minutes. Over 3 minutes means the tunnel is idle or broken. Peers that never connected are not shown.

panels.title: Clients per interface
panels.description: Clients from /interface/wifi, /interface/wireless and legacy CAPsMAN registration tables

panels.title: Clients

targets.expr: (mikrotik_wireless_client_signal_dbm{name=~"$router"}) * on(name, interface, mac) group_left(hostname, ip, ssid) mikrotik_wireless_client_info{name=~"$router"}
(sum without (direction) (mikrotik_wireless_client_rate_bps{name=~"$router",direction="tx"})) * on(name, interface, mac) group_left(hostname, ip, ssid) mikrotik_wireless_client_info{name=~"$router"}
(sum without (direction) (mikrotik_wireless_client_rate_bps{name=~"$router",direction="rx"})) * on(name, interface, mac) group_left(hostname, ip, ssid) mikrotik_wireless_client_info{name=~"$router"}
(mikrotik_wireless_client_uptime_seconds{name=~"$router"}) * on(name, interface, mac) group_left(hostname, ip, ssid) mikrotik_wireless_client_info{name=~"$router"}

panels.description: Hostname and IP come from DHCP leases (lease comment wins over host-name). TX is from the access point to the client.

panels.title: Client signal

targets.expr: mikrotik_wireless_client_signal_dbm{name=~"$router"} * on(name, interface, mac) group_left(hostname, ip, ssid) mikrotik_wireless_client_info{name=~"$router"}

panels.description: Below -67 dBm is weak for voice/video, below -80 dBm is unusable

panels.title: Client traffic (top 10)

targets.expr: topk(10, rate(mikrotik_wireless_client_traffic_bytes{name=~"$router"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8 * on(name, interface, mac) group_left(hostname, ip, ssid) mikrotik_wireless_client_info{name=~"$router"})

panels.description: TX (to the client) above zero is shown below zero; counters reset when a client reconnects

panels.title: Collector status
panels.description: Failed collectors: check the exporter logs, or disable collectors the device does not support

panels.title: Collector duration
panels.description: Stacked: the top line is the full scrape time of a router; keep it below the exporter timeout
